title: MemoryGraft: Persistent Compromise of LLM Agents via Poisoned Experience Retrieval
why_relevant: Introduces a memory-poisoning attack on agentic RAG long-term memory, exploiting semantic retrieval to induce persistent behavioral drift. Relevant to adversarial corruption of retrieval stores.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on agent memory rather than canonical RAG knowledge base poisoning; narrow validation on MetaGPT.
suggested_section: Adversarial corruption: poisoning and memory attacks
